title: Commando
developer: Chris Butler, Rory Green, Chris Harvey
build: REMEMBER's crack "Commando +5HD" (CSDb release 40672, June 1997): a D64 headed "once upon a time", ID "-rem-", with the packed game and a saved high-score file. Compared with the 1985 Elite PAL release from the C64 Preservation Project at the hand-over to the game ($0850): 29 of the game's 19,450 bytes differ.

tools.host: Linux x86_64, Ubuntu 24.04.5 cloud container, four cores, no display
tools.browser: Chromium 1194 via Playwright 1.56.1 (preinstalled in the container)

accuracy.note: first run, 52.8 % of the image; every comment later rewritten
second run rewrote every comment from the bytes, to 100 %
60 hand-written and 10 map comments; fifteen more with the same claim then corrected

exclude: the rest of REMEMBER's screen at $0400 (its menu and the instructions viewer, $4763, $476F), spaces at the hand-over; the game's variables end at $0512 and no game code reads or writes past them
sprite block $41, the name entry's gunsight: blank as loaded, written by $0A57 from $0A7F
sprite block $FF, the blank block: $3E93 zeroes it before anything is shown, over a near copy of block $AC
the game's screen and sprite pointers, rewritten whole before play ($3F75, $4081); at the hand-over it still holds a copy of REMEMBER's last two menu lines ($7F60-$7FAF) at $E118-$E167
extra: area 0's map, 200 rows of 40 characters, and the zeros after it
area 1's map and the zeros after it
area 3's map and the zeros after it
the character sets of areas 0 and 1
include: the text character set's first glyphs, in the RAM under the I/O area
the rest of the text character set and area 3's, in the RAM under the I/O area

io: CHAREN cleared from $0A63 to $0A74: the gunsight's stores reach the RAM under the I/O area
regions: Rob Hubbard's music driver, its tables, tracks and patterns
